metadata.title: Warm Toned Portrait with Elegant Script

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, monochromatic-leaning portrait featuring a subject in textured white clothing against a golden-ochre background with high-contrast black script and sans-serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat design is needed
outdoor natural landscapes are the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A seated portrait of a woman with vibrant red hair wearing a heavily textured white pearl-encrusted coat, set against a warm, mottled golden-brown background. The composition is balanced by elegant black typography on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm ochre background tones harmonize with the subject's red hair.
High-contrast black typography provides a focal point against the soft background.
The intricate texture of the pearl coat contrasts with the smooth skin and soft-focus background.
The subject's seated posture creates a diagonal line leading to the text block.
coreInvariants: Warm, monochromatic color palette dominated by gold, cream, and ochre.
Combination of fluid script and rigid sans-serif typography.
Soft, diffused lighting that minimizes harsh shadows.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium-full shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large script 'R' in the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face, down the line of the arm, across to the typography on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right quadrant to accommodate text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value in the subject; medium saturation in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant calligraphic script paired with a geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script features high stroke contrast and long, fluid swashes.
Sans-serif is all-caps with wide tracking and uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'R' in script has an exaggerated top loop and descending tail.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, fluid script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast swashes of the display text.
Provides the geometric, all-caps contrast needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with short red hair, wearing a white pearl-textured coat, seated on a cream sofa against a warm ochre mottled wall. Leave the right side of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large black script name in the upper right, followed by a smaller, wide-tracked all-caps sans-serif title directly below it.

verificationChecks: Is the background warm and mottled?
Is the script text high-contrast black?
Is the coat texture visibly pearlescent?

adjustableVariables: Density of the pearl texture on the coat
Tracking width of the subtitle text
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Reba'
Do not use the specific title 'If You See Him'
Do not include the 'enhanced CD' logo

mustAchieve: Soft, flattering lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script font does not overlap the subject's face.
Ensure the warm tones are consistent across the skin and background.
Verify the pearl texture appears three-dimensional.
Confirm the sans-serif text is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated Portrait + Pearl Texture + Warm Ochre Palette + Script/Sans-Serif Pairing
